title: Surface codes for quantum error correction
abstract: We study the surface code as a quantum error-correcting code on a two-dimensional lattice. Logical qubits are protected by measuring stabilizers, and we estimate error thresholds under circuit-level noise. Lattice surgery is used to perform logical gates.

title: Neural decoding of surface-code syndromes
abstract: Decoding syndromes from surface codes is a bottleneck for fault-tolerant quantum computing. A neural decoder matches minimum-weight perfect matching on depolarizing noise and scales to larger code distances.

title: Coherence limits of superconducting qubits
abstract: Superconducting qubits lose coherence through dielectric loss and quasiparticle noise. We measure relaxation and dephasing times and discuss how noise affects quantum error rates, without implementing a surface code.

title: Quantum chemistry with variational circuits
abstract: Variational quantum circuits approximate molecular ground-state energies. The method targets electronic structure, not error correction, and is tested on small molecules such as hydrogen and lithium hydride.

title: Surface chemistry of heterogeneous catalysts
abstract: Metal surfaces catalyze hydrogenation. We map adsorption sites and reaction barriers on platinum surfaces. The word surface here refers to chemistry, not topological quantum codes.

title: Transformers for protein structure prediction
abstract: A transformer model predicts protein three-dimensional structure from amino-acid sequence. Attention captures long-range contacts. Accuracy approaches experimental structures on CASP benchmark targets.

title: Protein language models improve folding
abstract: Language models trained on protein sequences learn evolutionary constraints. Fine-tuning them for structure prediction improves folding accuracy for proteins without close homologs.

title: Docking ligands into enzyme active sites
abstract: We dock small molecules into enzyme active sites to predict binding poses. Scoring functions rank candidate inhibitors. The work is about molecular docking, not sequence-to-structure transformers.

title: Transformers for machine translation
abstract: An encoder-decoder transformer translates sentences between languages. Multi-head attention replaces recurrence. Results are reported on WMT translation benchmarks, not on proteins.

title: Wheat yield forecasting from satellite imagery
abstract: Satellite images and weather records forecast wheat yield at the county scale. Vegetation indices such as NDVI track crop growth. Forecast error drops against a historical baseline.

title: Remote sensing of maize drought stress
abstract: Multispectral satellite imagery detects drought stress in maize fields. Canopy temperature and reflectance predict yield loss before harvest. Maps are validated with farm surveys.

title: Routing for satellite communication networks
abstract: Low-earth-orbit satellites need dynamic routing. We schedule inter-satellite links to reduce latency. This paper is about communications, not crop yield.

title: Solid-state electrolytes for lithium batteries
abstract: Sulfide solid-state electrolytes conduct lithium ions without a flammable liquid. We measure ionic conductivity and the stability of the lithium-metal interface in solid-state batteries.

title: Liquid electrolytes in lithium-ion cells
abstract: Carbonate liquid electrolytes transport lithium ions between graphite anodes and layered-oxide cathodes. Additives improve cycle life. The cells are conventional lithium-ion batteries, not solid-state.

title: State of charge estimation for electric vehicles
abstract: An observer estimates battery state of charge from voltage and current on an electric vehicle. The paper does not study electrolyte chemistry.

title: Paleography of medieval Latin manuscripts
abstract: Scribes in medieval scriptoria copied Latin manuscripts. We classify handwriting styles to date parchment fragments. The study is historical.

title: Coral bleaching on warming reefs
abstract: Marine heatwaves bleach coral reefs. We track recovery of coral cover after temperature spikes using diver surveys and satellite sea-surface temperatures.

title: Short-term urban traffic prediction
abstract: Graph neural networks forecast traffic speed on city roads. Sensors provide five-minute counts. The model helps signal timing.

title: Gravitational waves from binary black holes
abstract: Merging binary black holes radiate gravitational waves. We estimate masses and spins from the waveform detected by interferometers and compare them with numerical relativity.

title: Improvisation in jazz harmony
abstract: Jazz musicians improvise over chord changes. We analyze lead sheets to describe common harmonic substitutions. This is a musicology paper.

title: Glacier mass balance in a warming climate
abstract: Glaciers lose mass as the climate warms. We combine altimetry and field stakes to estimate annual mass balance for a mountain range.

title: Register allocation in optimizing compilers
abstract: Graph coloring assigns variables to CPU registers. We spill fewer registers on control-flow graphs from open-source compilers.

title: Vaccine cold-chain logistics
abstract: Vaccines must stay cold during transport. We plan routes for refrigerated trucks to reduce temperature excursions.

title: Radio imaging of black hole shadows
abstract: Very-long-baseline interferometry images the shadow of a supermassive black hole. The measurement is electromagnetic, not a gravitational-wave detection of a stellar-mass merger.
